# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

This repository contains no code of its own: every add-on listed here is built and
published from its own repository. If you found a security issue in one of the add-ons,
please report it in that add-on's repository instead.

For an issue with this repository itself, open a
[security advisory](https://github.com/shawly/hassio-addons/security/advisories/new).
Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public issues.
